newsitem.title: USA: Sands insiders to sell 46 pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: Sands insiders to sell 46 pct of stock.

text.p: Sands Regent Inc Chairman Katherene Latham, Director Deborah Lundgren and Chief Executive Officer Pete Cladianos Monday agreed to sell all their company stock, or 46 percent of the outstanding shares, to Las Vegas-based Desert Golden Sun, LLC.
In a statement, Cladianos said he and all other executive officers of Sands Regent will continue to manage the company, and "operations will generally continue as before."
Sands Regent operates a 1,000 room hotel/casino in Reno and the Copa Casino in Gulfport, Mississippi.

The three executives plan to sell just under 2.1 million shares to Desert Golden Sun. New York-based investment firm, Madeleine LLC, is providing financing for Desert Golden Sun, and Madeleine currently controls about 8.5 percent of Sands Regent common stock.
The sale is subject to definitive documentation and regulatory approvals, among other items.
